name: eat_snack
text: Holding a snack bag low in their right hand, a standing person picks a snack with their left hand and brings it to their mouth to eat, then lowers the left hand.

scene.description: Start at level ground facing +Z. Holding a snack bag low in their right hand, a standing person picks a snack with their left hand and brings it to their mouth to eat, then lowers the left hand. Hold held_snack_bag with right at its grip marker. The right hand steadies the snack bag near the right thigh; the left hand eats the small snack. Keep the held object outside the torso and legs, and keep fingers and forearms on the intended grasp side.
